in_sanskrit.name: इन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The deity of the sky, rain, and thunderbolts in Hindu mythology. He is the king of gods and the husband of the goddess Sachi (Saraswati).

in_hindi.name: इन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Indra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'indhra', which means 'rain-god'. Indra is considered as the god of rain and thunder in Hindu mythology.

in_tamil.name: இந்திர
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Indir is derived from the words 'indhu' meaning 'ocean' and 'ra' meaning 'lord'. It is considered to be a name of Lord Vishnu and is also used as a royal name.

in_telugu.name: ఇన్ద్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Indru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'indra', which means 'rain-god'. It is also considered as a name of Lord Shiva and is used as a royal name.

in_marathi.name: Indar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Heavens
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indar is the name of the God of Rains, Wind and Thunder in Hindu Mythology. He is also known as the King of Heaven. In the Vedas, Indra is depicted as the god of rain, thunder, and the sky. He is also the god of war and power. Indra is the god of the Indian subcontinent and is one of the most important deities in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Indar

in_bengali.long_meaning: Indar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Indar is the name of the God of Rains, Wind and Thunder in Hindu Mythology. He is also known as the King of Heaven. In the Vedas, Indra is depicted as the god of rain, thunder, and the sky. He is also the god of war and power. Indra is the god of the Indian subcontinent and is one of the most important deities in Hinduism.
